Notes: MP1 on file is **MP1 v1** (OPA2211 + 3 x 470 ohm CRCW2512 per leg, 26 x 36 mm); MP1 v2 (LMH6629 / IXTY08N100D2 / TMUX7212 / TPS65131 / BAT54 / BAV199) is closed in SPICE only (rf2_mp1v2_close.json) and waits for its fin board (HV1, 170 deg). TXF is TXJ's function as the first fin board (186 deg). LR1 copper is reported only by the zone rules (display flex). TXD, PWR, HB2-M / HB2-G (chassis) and the RF2 rework of AB1A / AB1B / CB1D (Phase C) have no board yet.
